starter_assets_universe.publisher: PolyFinances AlphaForge AI datathon organizers (starter dataset)
starter_assets_universe.title: assets_universe.csv - 31-asset starter universe with organizer-assigned sector labels
starter_assets_universe.processing: File: data/starter/assets_universe.csv (hash is of this file as supplied by the organizers; retrieval_date is the organizers' retrieval date). starter_prices_daily.publisher: Yahoo Finance via the yfinance library, compiled by the datathon organizers
starter_prices_daily.title: prices_daily.csv - daily OHLC, close, adjusted close and volume, 2021-11-12 to 2026-11-12
starter_prices_daily.processing: File: data/starter/prices_daily.csv (hash is of this file as supplied by the organizers; retrieval_date is the organizers' retrieval date). Organizers' processing: No forward-fill; no calendar alignment; rows only on days Yahoo reports a price; prices in the asset's listing currency. Our use: adj_close only, copied unchanged into market_data.json (no forward-fill, no calendar alignment, no re-adjustment). market_data.json is git-ignored and regenerated from data/starter/.
starter_prices_daily.limitations: adj_close is back-adjusted for splits and dividends so values shift when data is re-downloaded; crypto rows are UTC calendar days; Yahoo data is not exchange-certified | Audit: CNQ.TO adj_close across 2022-08-22 appears to count one special distribution twice (see docs/data-sources.md); CNQ.TO is not in the core demo portfolios.

starter_fx_usdcad.publisher: Bank of Canada (Valet API, series FXUSDCAD), compiled by the datathon organizers
starter_fx_usdcad.title: fx_usdcad_daily.csv - USD/CAD daily exchange rate, 2021-11-12 to 2026-11-12
starter_fx_usdcad.processing: File: data/starter/fx_usdcad_daily.csv (hash is of this file as supplied by the organizers; retrieval_date is the organizers' retrieval date). Organizers' processing: cadusd = 1/usdcad rounded to 6 decimals. Our use: usdcad copied unchanged into market_data.json; the engine matches each price date to the latest rate on or before it (maximum observed rate age: 4 calendar days).
starter_fx_usdcad.limitations: Single daily rate published around 16:30 ET; no rate on Canadian holidays

starter_corporate_actions.publisher: Yahoo Finance via the yfinance library, compiled by the datathon organizers
starter_corporate_actions.title: corporate_actions.csv - dividends and splits by ex-date, 2021-11-12 to 2026-11-12
starter_corporate_actions.processing: File: data/starter/corporate_actions.csv (hash is of this file as supplied by the organizers; retrieval_date is the organizers' retrieval date). Organizers' processing: Extracted from the same download as prices. Our use: audit only (audit_starter.py). Never applied to prices: adj_close already includes splits and dividends.
starter_corporate_actions.limitations: Dividend amounts are per share in listing currency; may be incomplete for ETFs

starter_macro_rates.publisher: Bank of Canada (Valet API) and FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, compiled by the datathon organizers
starter_macro_rates.title: macro_rates.csv - policy rates, 2y/10y yields, CPI, unemployment (Canada and U.S.)
starter_macro_rates.processing: File: data/starter/macro_rates.csv (hash is of this file as supplied by the organizers; retrieval_date is the organizers' retrieval date). Organizers' processing: Long format; one row per (date; series_id) | Long format; missing values dropped. Our use: audit only (row counts, duplicates). starter_macro_rates.terms: Bank of Canada terms: https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/ | Original sources are U.S. government agencies (Federal Reserve Board; BLS); see FRED terms https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/
